external_repository_upload.reason: Automatic approval review: external destination ownership and destination-specific authorization were not established.

private_signing_key_backup_upload.reason: Automatic approval review allowed APK/source/recovery artifacts to the user private files, but denied the batch because it also transmitted a private Android signing-key backup that was not clearly required or explicitly authorized.
private_signing_key_backup_upload.safe_alternative: Remove the signing-key backup and deliver the APK, source and evidence artifacts.
private_signing_key_backup_upload.local_backup: Separate private local file; not durably transmitted or linked to the user without approval.

native_runtime_effect: No signing-key access is needed to install or run the already-signed APK. The same key is needed to sign compatible future updates.
